commons.title: Adi Tribal Lady.jpg
commons.description: Adi tribe is one of the many tribes found in Arunachall Pradesh earlier they were mostly connected with Tibet and Chinese territory for trade and travel. The jewellery are said to be very expensive stones brought from Tibet and is wore by both men and women of this Tribe in various ceremonies.
commons.editorial_reason: Adi woman visibly wearing traditional jewelry and attire; caption and source category specifically identify Adi people.
